findings.issue: שֶׂה is one animal of the flock (sheep or goat); «cordero» narrows it to a young sheep.
הָאֱלֹהִים is definite masculine plural; «Dios» is singular and capitalized, changing number and treating the common noun as a divine title.
כִּי is an unmarked conjunction; «Porque» selects the causal sense inside the saying.
הוּא זֶה is pronoun then demonstrative; «esto él» reverses that order.

notes: Anarthrous plural אֱלֹהִים as «dioses» matches that token’s number.
